title: 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Wireless Gaming Controller ~AUD $25.45 Delivered @ 8Bitdo Official Store via AliExpress
body:
Deal: 8BitDo Ultimate 2C Wireless Gaming Controller ~AUD $25.45 Delivered @ 8Bitdo Official Store via AliExpress

[shrugies] Great price, great controller, get it! Just be mindful there is also a different switch edition too
[RichardL] Just be mindful there is also a different switch edition too
For the Nintendo Switch you'll want the 'Bluetooth' Version, which you can usually differentiate by the Nintendo ABXY Layout.
[19199090] Came here to say the exact same thing but you beat me to it
[x d] Added the link to the switch version. Probably around the same price with the discount too.
[JoeOz] I love 8BitDo controllers but they really need to work on their naming
[kwchaz] https://www.reddit.com/r/Controller/comments/1utiddz/connect…
Apparently yes, on an older firmware.
[Wheresmyspaceship] Can anyone couch for something on AliExpress for playing games on my phone like the Backbone One?
[x d] Haven't tested them myself, but the description says it works on Android.
[mmd] Silly question:how does it connect to the pc? I could understand laptop have Bluetooth
[RichardL] Either wireless connection via the included Dongle (2.4G Adapter) or wired via USB Cable.
[x d] No you need to look for the Switch version - which is here : https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005006593373628.html?spm=a2…
[reece8] how many controllers can a single dongle connect? multiple or just one per dongle?
silly question but would the switch version via BT work on PC too?
[kalakaar] Similar question, will the BT version work on android tv?
[crentist] This or a gamesir nova lite (1 or 2) ?
They all seem basically the same and similar prices, although gamesir has more flared sides like an Xbox controller.
Would be for PC and Mac gaming, eg playing switch games on a Mac
[MikeySteele] I have a nova lite 2 and one of these, and I feel the ultimate 2c is a step-up in quality.
[Hurg] Got a blue/orange for $22.56, cheers op :)
[breadylonglegs] Can this be used to pilot a submersible? Asking for a friend
[TruckTrespass] You can, just be mindful that if there's a sudden and instant disconnection, it's likely to be on the submersible's end
[expertreader] Does anyone know if you can use two of these on Xbox series S? I already have one but would like to know if two will work
[A female dog] Idk why but it was only approx $18 for me after entering code.
[MeesusEff] I applied the code but it's still showing me $32.74, the coupon was only slightly more than the tax. What am I doing wrong 😭
[Aldonis] good quality (though battery is nowhere as good as the genuine Nintendo Pro controller which now has developed stick drift and which this 8Bitdo one should not with its Hall Effect sticks)
are they?
